info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Market Data By Param1-spec
info.description: This API provides access to detailed market data for financial instruments identified by specific parameters. Users can retrieve comprehensive reference data essential for financial analysis, trading strategies, and risk management. Typical consumers include fintech applications, investment platforms, and market analysts seeking timely and accurate market insights. The API allows for efficient querying of the relevant financial instrument information based on the provided parameter, ensuring that users can make informed decisions based on the latest market data.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve reference data for a specific financial instrument identified by RES-100045. It provides essential information that aids in understanding the instrument characteristics and its market behavior.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving financial instrument reference data specific to the identifier RES-100045. This body may contain parameters that specify the details of the financial instrument being queried.

200.description: The request was successful, and the financial instrument reference data is returned.

GetMarketDataByParam1Request.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation in the financial instrument reference data management API.

GetMarketDataByParam1Response_200.title: Financial Instrument Reference Data

instrumentId.description: The unique identifier for the financial instrument.

isin.description: The International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) for the financial instrument.

marketIdentifierCode.description: The code identifying the market where the financial instrument is traded.

asOf.description: The date as of which the reference data is applicable.

dataSource.description: The source from which the data was obtained.

instrumentType.description: The type of the financial instrument (e.g., stock, bond).

ticker.description: The stock ticker symbol for the financial instrument.

issueCurrency.description: The currency in which the financial instrument is issued.

recordStatus.description: The status of the record (e.g., active, inactive).

version.description: The version number of the financial instrument record.

updatedAt.description: The timestamp of the last update to the record.

metadata.description: Metadata related to the financial instrument data.

GetMarketDataByParam1Response_200.description: Schema representing the reference data for financial instruments.
